text:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: model=v12.4 tag=r12-20260317 -> prod. Canary started at 5% traffic. Link: https://ci.redwood.example/release/r12
carla: seeing garbled outputs on canary, samples coming in from monitoring. Small batch attached — responses look like tokenization garbage.
carla: ```user_id: 12345 output: "����<unk> hello"```
jess: who promoted r12? that tag should have used weightset r12a, but the manifest shows `weights: r12-broken` in the release metadata. can someone check artifact mapping?
mike: paging SRE (p0) — canary error rate x8, tokenization errors. @carla can you confirm customer-facing sessions impacted? :pager:
deploy-bot: Alert: canary error rate 8.3x -> 12.7% failing generations; latency 2x. Top error: TokenizerMismatchError (retokenization failure).
carla: CS reports 4 customers with degraded streaming responses; queued tickets being opened. marking customer-impact = true.
jess: quick check: `s3://models/r12/manifest.json` shows tokenizer_version: "v3.0-legacy" but expected "v4.1". weightset hash: `sha256:deadbeef...` does not match promoted artifact `r12a` hash. looks like wrong artifact promoted.
liz: we should flip model-routing kill-switch and route traffic to fallback stable variant v11.9. prepping command: `redwood route set --model default --variant v11.9 --mode emergency`
carla: executing kill-switch now. running commands, will post output.
carla: `> redwood route set --model default --variant v11.9 --mode emergency` 
carla: done — traffic now routed to v11.9 for production. Observability: generation errors dropped to baseline within 30s. :white_check_mark:
neil: starting rollback of r12 artifacts from registries and revoking artifact tag r12. also starting restart of affected workers to clear cached KV tokenizers.
mike: oncall handoff: infra lead neil taking lead. I'm coordinating with CS for affected customers and with infra for rollback. tagging postmortem owners.
deploy-bot: Automated: rollback job queued (job id 98321). Will report success/failure.
neil: rollback completed, tag r12 removed, workers restarted, canaries back to normal. patch applied to artifact-promotion pipeline to block tag reuse until checksum verified.
support-bot: Created support tickets for 4 customers and one incident notification to partners. Ticket IDs: SUP-2112, SUP-2113, SUP-2114, SUP-2115.
carla: immediate mitigations done. next steps: 1) require tokenizer checksum preflight in release pipeline, 2) add artifact-to-weight hash comparison in canary health checks, 3) add automated canary ramp guard (stop at 1% if tokenization mismatch metric spikes).
jess: also propose a short lockdown: disable manual promotion for 24h and audit last 3 promotions. I'll open a PR with pipeline checks.
mike: timeline notes: deploy r12 at 10:02 UTC; first errors at 10:05; kill-switch flipped 10:08; rollback done 10:12. CS notified and tickets opened.
carla: will draft pager incident summary and postmortem. assigning owners: jess (release pipeline checks), neil (rollback/infra changes), liz (customer comms).
support-bot: Notifying affected customers with temporary mitigation details and ETA for fix.
deploy-bot: Incident resolved: service stabilized. Creating incident record and linking CI logs.
carla: thanks team. switching to postmortem thread.
